{{- /* creator/excerpt.html — clean card excerpt from the engine summary (arch/26 §3). Input: (dict "summary" .Summary "title" ). Output: plain text, max 120 chars. Foundry's auto summary is the rendered first N words of the body, so a leading "# Title" and inline #tags end up in it. Drop headings, tag links, bare #tags, a lone "Tags:" label line and a leading line that just repeats the title, so the card starts with body prose. */ -}} {{- $h := printf "%v" .summary -}} {{- $h = replaceRE `]*>[\s\S]*?` " " $h -}} {{- $h = replaceRE `]*class="[^"]*\btag-link\b[^"]*"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?` " " $h -}} {{- $t := $h | plainify -}} {{- $t = replaceRE `(^|\s)#[A-Za-z_\u00C0-\uFFFF][^\s#]*` " " $t -}} {{- $t = replaceRE `(^|\n)[ \t]*([Tt][Aa][Gg][Ss]?|标签)[ \t]*[:：]?[ \t]*(?=\n|$)` "\n" $t -}} {{- $t = trim $t " \t\r\n" -}} {{- with .title -}}{{- if hasPrefix $t (printf "%s\n" .) -}}{{- $t = trim (strings.TrimPrefix . $t) " \t\r\n" -}}{{- end -}}{{- end -}} {{- $t = trim (replaceRE `\s+` " " $t) " " -}} {{- if $t -}}{{- $t = $t | truncate 120 -}}{{- end -}} {{- return $t -}}
